headline: Bowers fall to 1-9; a benched McMillan cost 14.1 points
dek: ATX Bowers lost 139.8 to 99.1 to Moore Than A Bite, and even a perfect lineup (114.6) wouldn't have won.

sections.title: Your week
sections.md:
ATX Bowers lost to Moore Than A Bite, **99.1 to 139.8**, and sit at 1-9.

- **Left on bench:** 15.5 points (86% efficiency). The best possible lineup scored 114.6, still 25 short, so this one wasn't lost on start/sit.
- **MVP:** Ladd McConkey, **20.7**, against a pregame projection of 6.94.
- **Dud:** Brenton Strange, **4.6** at TE.
- **Biggest miss:** Tetairoa McMillan (19.1) sat while Jauan Jennings (5.0) started, a **14.1-point** swing. Starting DeVonta Smith (9.1) over Deebo Samuel Sr. (7.7) would have added 1.4.
- **Underperformers:** Bo Nix scored 12.5 against our 18.87 projection, on 24.8 expected fantasy points. Tony Pollard scored 11.0 against 18.81.

Moore Than A Bite got 26.0 from Chuba Hubbard, 25.4 from Travis Kelce, 23.1 from DJ Moore and 19.3 from Jameson Williams.

Week 12 claims are in for a QB, a K and a D/ST. They run Wed 11/25 at 12:05 AM PT. The QB claim uses the open spot with no drop, and a fallback is lined up if it fails. Nix is still on the roster, so you aren't short at QB.

sections.title: Could you have known?
sections.md:
Both benching mistakes were ones our projection flagged.

**McMillan over Jennings (14.1 points lost): our projection pointed the right way.**
- Our projection was 13.7 for McMillan and 3.08 for Jennings.
- McMillan played 83% of snaps over his last three games, with a 24% target share and 14.9 xFP.
- Jennings had 60% of snaps, an 8% target share and 4.0 xFP.
- CAR's implied total was 23.5, against 20.0 for MIN.
- The actual result, 19.1 to 5.0, was a bit better than projected for McMillan. The direction was clear.

**Smith over Deebo (1.4 points lost): our projection pointed the right way, but barely mattered.**
- Our projection was 15.94 for Smith and 11.3 for Deebo.
- Smith had a 34% target share and 18.5 xFP over his last three, against 14% and 9.0 for Deebo.
- Smith's PHI implied total was a low 17.0, and he has only 4 games in our sample.
- Neither player did much (9.1 vs 7.7).

McConkey's 20.7 against a 6.94 projection was variance. Nothing pregame suggested it.

sections.title: Top performers
sections.md:
- **QB:** Dak Prescott scored 35.9 on 33.8 xFP for The Dakstreet Boys, so the usage backed it up. Patrick Mahomes (25.0, Lover Boys) and Fernando Mendoza (22.9, Bucky Charms) followed. Justin Herbert (22.4) and Cam Ward (22.2) were unrostered.
- **RB:** Jonah Coleman scored 34.9 for I Love it Ra, then Ashton Jeanty (27.9, Just Win Baby), Jahmyr Gibbs (27.8) and Chuba Hubbard (26.0, Moore Than A Bite). Coleman is one of the two players you sent out in the trade.
- **WR:** CeeDee Lamb scored 30.2, with George Pickens at 23.8 on a huge 29.4 xFP. Jack Bech (22.8) was unrostered.
- **TE:** Travis Kelce scored 25.4 on 15.0 xFP, and George Kittle scored 18.4 on 7.7. Both beat their usage by a lot, so expect some regression. Mitchell Evans (15.4) and Evan Engram (13.4) were unrostered.
- **K and D/ST:** Jake Elliott and Drew Stevens both scored 18.0 and were unrostered. CHI D/ST scored 17.0 and SF D/ST 16.0, both for Game of Throws.

**Usage without the points:**
- Parker Washington: 18.3 on 31.6 xFP.
- Trevor Lawrence: 12.7 on 27.1.
- Cam Skattebo: 5.8 on 20.3.
- Caleb Douglas: 5.0 on 18.4.
- Your Nix: 24.8 xFP, with the points not following.

sections.title: Your trade
sections.md:
You got Omarion Hampton, Tetairoa McMillan and DeVonta Smith. You gave Rashee Rice and Jonah Coleman.

**ROS points through Week 18:**
- Got: **233.0** (Smith 95.8, McMillan 76.7, Hampton 60.5).
- Gave: **146.6** (Coleman 88.4, Rice 58.2).
- You win by **86.4** on the total. Part of that is just having three players against two. Per player it's 77.7 against 73.3, so the edge is smaller than it looks.

**Per game:**
- Got: 40.2 combined (Smith 15.6, McMillan 15.0, Hampton 9.6).
- Gave: 29.3 combined (Coleman 16.3, Rice 13.0).
- The combined totals favor you, but per player it's 13.4 against 14.65. The side you gave has the better per-player average, and Coleman is the best single player in the deal.

**The pain point:** Coleman scored 34.9 this week for I Love it Ra, the team on the other side. His last-three average is 24.7 on 20.3 xFP and 76% of snaps, so the usage was real. Our projection has him at 15.5 next week, against 16.5 for Smith, 13.2 for McMillan and 10.6 for Hampton.

**What it does to your roster:**
- WR is now crowded: Smith, McMillan, Samuel, Boston, McConkey, Dell, Addison and Jennings.
- RB is thin: Pollard (92.2 ROS), Aaron Jones (63.5) and Hampton (60.5), with nobody behind them.
- TE is Strange and Kincaid, and QB is Nix.
- A 3-for-2 adds a player rather than opening a spot. Your notes say a spot is open, so check your roster count before the QB claim runs.

The trade deadline is this week (Week 11). If you want to turn the WR surplus into RB depth, an idea worth a look would be a WR for a back from a team short at WR. Otherwise the waiver wire is your main lever from here.

sections.title: Injuries on the field
sections.md:
**Yours:**
- **Omarion Hampton:** he's healthy (14 carries for 89 yards). The injury was to his teammate Keaton Mitchell, who left early with a knee injury. The news says that provided a bigger boost to Kimani Vidal, who had nine touches and 54 scrimmage yards. Vidal is next up at 43% of snaps and unrostered.
- **Tetairoa McMillan:** Jalen Coker (Sebas350) took a helmet-to-helmet hit late and entered the concussion protocol, but was cleared Monday. McMillan was listed as next up at 83% of snaps. Nothing changes for him.

**Around the league:**
- **Derrick Henry (The Dakstreet Boys):** concussion evaluation after a hard landing on a TD run, no update in the news. Justice Hill (Chentudo El Venudo) is next up and had a season-high 36 snaps. He scored 17.6 in PPR.
- **Michael Mayer (Lover Boys):** left with an injury, with Brock Bowers already out. Ian Thomas is next up, unrostered, and caught a 19-yard TD.
- **Juwan Johnson (Chentudo El Venudo):** hamstring. Noah Fant, unrostered, is next up at 68% of snaps.
- **Seth McGowan (SMA):** hamstring, will miss some time. Jonathan Taylor, also SMA's, is next up.
- **Bhayshul Tuten (Just Win Baby):** re-aggravated his ankle but "wasn't too bad", so he'll be monitored in practice. Chris Rodriguez Jr. (unrostered) is next up at 38% of snaps.
- **DJ Moore (Moore Than A Bite):** helped off with a knee issue, then returned and scored 23.1. Khalil Shakir (Sebas350) was the next-up option had he not.
- **Travis Kelce (Moore Than A Bite):** briefly left with an ankle injury, returned, and was a full participant Wednesday.
